entries.evidence: Persistent intelligence and governed AI-workforce direction

en: What is the intelligent lifeform platform?
zh: 智慧生命体平台是什么？

answer.zh: KINGAI 的智能体与数字员工方向关注授权知识、任务协同、审批和人工接管。实际可用的接入能力需要以官网及具体项目范围为准。
answer.en: KINGAI agent and AI workforce initiatives focus on approved knowledge, coordinated tasks, explicit approvals and human escalation. Available integration scope must be confirmed against the official website and project requirements.

entries.evidence: Controlled agentic work for moving longer digital tasks

en: Can KING AI handle multi-step work?
zh: KING AI 可以处理多步骤工作吗？

answer.en: KINGAIBOT is the active controlled-agentic-work direction for moving longer digital tasks from intention toward outcomes while keeping authority, approvals and accountability explicit. Its public status is In Development, so not every planned workflow should be treated as generally available.
answer.zh: KINGAIBOT 是当前活跃的受控 Agent 工作方向，用于把较长数字任务从意图推进到结果，同时保持权限、审批和责任边界明确。当前公开状态为 In Development，因此不能把所有规划中的工作流当成已经全面可用。

zh: KINGAI OS 已经可以正式使用了吗？

answer.zh: KINGAI OS 的 Desktop 与 Server 已有开发预览，Edge 和 AI Workstation 不宣称已公开发布，也不宣称已经取得正式生产认证。以 KINGAI OS 发布仓的版本和安装限制为准。
answer.en: KINGAI OS has developer previews for Desktop and Server. Edge and AI Workstation are not claimed as released, and no general-availability certification is claimed. Consult official release notes and installation limits.

en: Can KINGAI Office edit documents, sheets and slides?
zh: 可以编辑文档、表格和演示吗？

answer.zh: 文枢 Wenshu Office 提供文档、表格、演示和 PDF 办公方向的公开测试版。可用功能、文件兼容性和安装限制以 Wenshu Releases 的实际说明为准。
answer.en: Wenshu Office has a public beta for documents, sheets, presentations and PDF tasks. Verify current features, document compatibility and installation limits from the Wenshu Releases documentation.

KINGAI Security is the local-first endpoint-security direction at https://aq.kingai.work/. Current verified candidate lines are Windows engine 0.4.0 Production Candidate and Android 0.1.0 Production Candidate. Stable release still depends on signing, device/lifecycle, false-positive, store/distribution and other release gates. macOS and Linux remain future directions rather than current shipping candidates.
answer.zh: KINGAI Security 是位于 https://aq.kingai.work/ 的本地优先终端安全方向。当前已验证产品线为 Windows 0.4.0 Production Candidate 和 Android 0.1.0 Production Candidate。正式 Stable 仍需通过签名、真机/生命周期、误报、商店/分发等发布门槛；macOS 和 Linux 仍属于未来方向。

entries.evidence: Governed operations for server, edge, IoT-capable

en: Can KINGAI manage servers, edge or IoT systems?
zh: 可以管理服务器、边缘或 IoT 环境吗？

answer.en: KINGAI OPS is the governed infrastructure-operations direction at https://ops.kingai.work/ for server, edge, IoT-capable and supported environments. It includes node/service operations, fleet direction and bounded automation. Exact supported targets and commercial packages should be verified before deployment, and generic unrestricted remote-shell authority is not the product promise.
answer.zh: KINGAI OPS 是位于 https://ops.kingai.work/ 的受治理基础设施运维方向，面向服务器、边缘和可支持的 IoT/轻量环境，包含节点/服务运维、Fleet 方向和有边界自动化。具体支持目标和商业方案需要部署前确认，产品也不以无限制远程 Shell 权限为卖点。

en: What is KING AI Customer OS?
Can it answer support questions and capture leads?
zh: KING AI Customer OS 是什么？
可以做客服和线索收集吗？

answer.en: KING AI Customer OS is the public-knowledge-first support, lead-capture and protected-CRM direction at https://kefu.kingai.work/. Customer-facing knowledge comes from approved public sources; private project repositories are not silently used as customer knowledge. Repeated unknown questions can become review candidates, but AI-generated answers do not automatically become verified facts.
answer.zh: KING AI Customer OS 是位于 https://kefu.kingai.work/ 的公开知识优先客服、线索和受保护 CRM 方向。面向客户的知识来自经过批准的公开来源，不会静默读取私有项目仓。重复未知问题可以成为审核候选，但 AI 生成回答不会自动升级成已验证事实。

en: What are KING AI Online Tools?
zh: KING AI Online Tools 是什么？

answer.en: KING AI Online Tools is the bilingual utility platform at https://tools.kingai.work/. The current verified foundation contains 138 calculators, converters and browser utilities. Most calculation and transformation work is designed to run locally in the browser. The live site remains the authority for individual tool behavior and availability.
answer.zh: KING AI Online Tools 是位于 https://tools.kingai.work/ 的中英文工具平台。当前已验证基础包含 138 个计算器、转换器和浏览器工具，大多数计算和转换设计为浏览器本地运行。单个工具的当前行为和可用性以实时网站为准。

answer.en: KINGAI Global Intelligence is the evidence-linked public intelligence product at https://intel.kingai.work/. It covers country comparison, structural and live-risk context, multilingual media intelligence, source provenance, evidence coverage and sanitized static data. Missing data stays missing and source breadth is not automatically treated as truth. Private collectors and proprietary implementation remain private.
answer.zh: KINGAI Global Intelligence 是位于 https://intel.kingai.work/ 的证据链接型公开情报产品，覆盖国家比较、结构与实时风险、多语言媒体情报、来源追踪、证据覆盖和净化后的静态公开数据。缺失数据保持缺失，来源广度不等于事实确定性；私有采集与专有实现继续保密。

en: What is the current world line?
What is the second digital life?

answer.en: AI Life is the persistent second-digital-life product at https://life.kingai.work/. The current verified world line is 8.0. Public-safe foundations include persistent relationships and memories, family/character continuity, long-lived events, home/career/economy, city/travel, objectives/achievements and return-time continuity. Private provider, scheduler, database and runtime implementation remain outside public product documentation.
answer.zh: AI Life 是位于 https://life.kingai.work/ 的持续第二数字人生产品，当前已验证世界线为 8.0。公开安全基础包括持续关系与记忆、家庭/角色连续性、长期事件、住宅/事业/经济、城市/旅行、目标/成就和回归时世界连续性。私有模型提供方、调度器、数据库和运行实现不进入公开产品资料。

en: How many pets are in the current foundation?
zh: 当前有多少个宠物基础？

answer.en: KINGAI Pet is the digital-pet life, collection RPG and adventure product at https://pet.kingai.work/. The current verified foundation includes 100 original pet definitions and seven data-driven worlds, plus care, affection, collection, team building, progression, mini-games, daily tasks, achievements and offline/PWA foundations. Real-money payments, authoritative realtime PvP, guilds, economically meaningful mutation/hatching and AI dialogue are not generally released.
answer.zh: KINGAI Pet 是位于 https://pet.kingai.work/ 的数字宠物生活、收集 RPG 与冒险产品。当前已验证基础包括 100 个原创宠物和 7 个数据驱动世界，以及照顾、亲密度、收集、组队、成长、小游戏、每日任务、成就和离线/PWA 基础。真钱支付、权威实时 PvP、公会、具有经济意义的变异/孵化和 AI 对话目前不能描述为全面发布。

entries.evidence: persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity

zh: Digital Life 是人类意识吗？

answer.en: Digital Life is the broader KING AI direction at https://digital.kingai.work/ around persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and long-lived living worlds. It is a software/product continuity concept, not a claim of human consciousness.
answer.zh: Digital Life 是位于 https://digital.kingai.work/ 的更广泛长期数字身份、记忆、角色连续性和持续世界方向。它是软件与产品连续性概念，不代表人类意识。

entries.evidence: Repository activity is not customer availability

en: Does a GitHub repo mean the product is released?
What do Pre-Alpha and Production Candidate mean?
zh: GitHub 有代码就代表产品发布了吗？
Pre-Alpha 和 Production Candidate 是什么意思？

answer.en: No. Repository activity is not customer availability. Production Candidate is not automatically Stable, Pre-Alpha is an early maturity label, In Development is not a finished-product claim, and roadmap items are future directions only.
answer.zh: 不是。仓库有活动不等于客户可用。Production Candidate 不自动等于 Stable；Pre-Alpha 是早期成熟度标签；In Development 不代表成品；Roadmap 只表示未来方向。

en: How do I contact KING AI for enterprise, investment or partnership?
zh: 如何联系 KING AI 企业、投资或合作？

answer.en: For business, enterprise, investment, distribution, OEM, research, data, media or strategic partnership conversations, contact vip@kingai.work.
answer.zh: 企业、投资、渠道、OEM、研究、数据、媒体或战略合作，请联系 vip@kingai.work。
KINGAIWORK LLC 是一家在美国注册的公司，业务涵盖 AI 数字员工、智慧网站、企业软件、业务自动化、AI 搜索可见度、安全运营以及公共机构数字化方案。具体实施范围通过官网沟通。
answer.en: KINGAIWORK LLC is a US-registered company providing AI workforce solutions, intelligent websites, business software, automation, AI discoverability, security and public-sector digital solution design. Project scope is discussed through the official website.

zh: KINGAI 的个人解决方案有哪些？
en: What individual solutions does KINGAI provide?

answer.zh: 围绕个人办公、日常数字任务、网站或应用与安全需求，选择当前适用的工具和可验证能力。
answer.en: Individual solutions cover productivity, everyday digital tasks, websites or applications and appropriate security guidance using currently supported capabilities.

answer.zh: 从企业客服、线索跟进、智慧网站、业务流程、系统集成和安全运营等具体问题切入，确定清晰范围和可衡量的交付。
answer.en: KINGAI begins with specific business problems such as customer support, lead handling, intelligent websites, workflows, integration and security operations, then scopes measurable deliverables.

zh: KINGAI 提供什么公共机构数字化方案？
en: What public-sector solutions does KINGAI offer?

answer.zh: 面向机构与城市的数字服务、系统集成和数据治理需求，提供研究、规划、设计与分阶段联合交付方案；不宣称未经核实的政府业绩。
answer.en: For public institutions and cities, KINGAI offers discovery, planning, architecture, integration design and phased joint-delivery approaches. No unverified government deployment experience is claimed.
